atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for EURUSD (RANGE_SPECIALIST). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=4.037, trend_persistence=0.28, mean_reversion=0.72. Learned timeframe weights: D1 (w=+0.249), H4 (w=+0.249), M15 (w=+0.249). Ablation-retained features: dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.496), liquidity_sweep (w=+0.273), bos_breakout (w=+0.168), sentinel_news_sentiment (w=+0.034) (pruned/left out by ablation: ema_trend, fvg_impulse, rsi_momentum).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for EURUSD (RANGE_SPECIALIST): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=4.037, mean-reversion=0.72). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to D1 (w=+0.249), H4 (w=+0.249), M15 (w=+0.249). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.496), liquidity_sweep (w=+0.273), bos_breakout (w=+0.168), sentinel_news_sentiment (w=+0.034)] and pruned [ema_trend, fvg_impulse, rsi_momentum].
